settings.headline: Why tiers?
settings.body: The first block is priced for indoor essentials. Higher summer use pays more because peak pumping and storage are sized for the hottest week, not the average day — the board minutes for the 2025 rate vote (story) walk through that math.
settings.side: Story policies: a once-a-year leak adjustment with a plumber's note, and a payment-plan option before shutoff, never after a same-day notice. Call the office in the story — in real life, use the number on your own bill.
